THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
161
STUDY 124
Black Mini Dress at Night
Rights check
Source: 25017.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy dark brown
hair walks along a city sidewalk at night. She wears a
fitted black long-sleeve mini dress with a pleated flared
skirt and a high, round neckline. Sheer black tights and
black pointed stiletto heels complete the look. Her
expression is calm, with a red lip. Soft streetlight and
blurred building edges. Palette of black, charcoal, and
warm streetlight amber. Classic and cinematic, in the
style of a night-out street photo.
Classic, cinematic, sleek
WORKING NOTES
- The flared pleated skirt and sheer tights are the key
details.
- Keep the streetlight for a warm, moody glow.
Try this: Keep the streetlight for a warm glow.
